facts: A new SavedData starts with dirty=false; setDirty marks it for persistence.
SavedData.save(File,Provider) serializes only when dirty. It invokes the abstract compound serializer before dispatching the NeoForge IO worker.
If a blocked subclass refuses compound serialization, the IO worker write is not scheduled by that call. A blocked sentinel must also never be dirtied or installed as a replacement empty journal.
NeoForge copies the serialized compound before the asynchronous IO worker write. Runtime cache cleanup must not erase the stored valid SavedData object or mutate its receipt collections.
